newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates steady, forint seen down vs doll.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates steady, forint seen down vs doll.

text.p: 0622 GMT - Hungary's overnight interest rates started higher on Wednesday but dropped back to Tuesday's closing level of 19.50 percent in abundant money supply, traders said.
* Overnight rates opened with offers of 20.00 percent but the first deal were struck at 19.875 percent later the rates eased to 19.50 percent.

* Traders said these market levels made the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility (standing at 20.00 percent) attractive, and with a tax payment deadline on July 10 the two factors could soak up some of the excess liquidity.
* The forint was seen opening weaker against the dollar at around 189.09/14, compared with Tuesday's close of 188.57/62 but right on the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid).
